title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a signed distance for a rounded box and a capsule
body:
## Problem
Session 1 only has a circle and a box; real parts use rounded corners and capsule shapes.

## Context
A rounded box is the box formula with the result reduced by a radius; a capsule is the distance to a line segment minus a radius.

## Expected outcome
Two new functions `sd_round_box` and `sd_capsule` with pictures in the same style.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checks for inside, outside and on-surface points
- [ ] A figure with both shapes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: marching cubes and an STL export
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: the repo extracts only 2D contours.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, milestone 1. Marching squares in Session 3 is the 2D version of the idea.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Mesh area of a unit sphere within 1 percent of 4 pi
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Add a lid and clearance check (assembly session)
body:
## Problem
Parts are never alone; students ask how an assembly is modelled.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 4. A lid is a second field moved by a translation; clearance is the smallest value of the union of the two shifted fields.

## Expected outcome
A lesson that places a lid on the mug with a 0.05 cm clearance and verifies it.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No overlap and a gap between 0.04 and 0.06 cm
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: sliders to volume
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a mug sculpted by sliders with a live volume readout; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation written from the roadmap, with an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Radius re-solved so the capacity stays 300 mL while the wall changes
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Add colour-blind-safe colours to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps colour fields blue and grey; some colour-blind users cannot tell inside from outside.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Inside and outside distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
